title: Week 5 review + practice exam warmup
topic: Week 5 synthesis: S3 lifecycle, Cost Explorer/Budgets/CUR, Fargate right-sizing and Spot, Step Functions capstone, Well-Architected tiers, cross-week exam traps (security, OLTP vs analytics, integration, NAT cost)
format: 30 timed scenario questions (~48 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-34-week-5-review.md and Nights 30–33. Complete before external 65-question Practice Exam 1. Answer without peeking at night-34-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×8 B×7 C×8 D×7 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Night 30 applied lifecycle to globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output/iceland/ with transitions at 90 and 365 days. Objects uploaded to iceland/2026-07/ this week remain S3 Standard. Which concept explains why nothing moved on deploy night?

options.A: Lifecycle transitions run on object age — not immediately when the rule is created
options.B: Glacier Flexible Retrieval blocks all transitions for 30 days globally
options.C: S3 lifecycle applies only to objects in us-west-2
options.D: Intelligent-Tiering must be enabled before any lifecycle rule works

questions.question: Finance needs an email when forecasted monthly spend crosses 80% of a $25 study-account cap. Which service sends that alert?

options.A: Cost Explorer saved report with no notification channel
options.B: AWS Budgets with FORECASTED threshold notifications
options.C: S3 Storage Lens dashboard export
options.D: CloudWatch alarm on the NAT Gateway BytesOut metric only

questions.question: CloudWatch shows Iceland Fargate tasks at p95 24% CPU and 38% memory on 2 vCPU / 4 GiB. The team wants to cut compute cost before any 1-year commit. Best first step?

options.A: Buy Compute Savings Plan for the current oversized task size
options.B: Register a lower CPU/memory task definition revision aligned to utilization
options.C: Move the batch to Aurora Serverless v2
options.D: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the output bucket

questions.question: The Iceland monthly batch tolerates a two-minute Spot interruption warning and retries next month. Which Fargate option best reduces per-run cost?

options.A: Fargate On-Demand with assignPublicIp ENABLED
options.B: Fargate Spot capacity on the RunTask / capacity provider strategy
options.C: EC2 Dedicated Hosts for license compliance
options.D: Lambda with 15-minute timeout for the full OSM download

questions.question: Night 32 deploys Step Functions while legacy EventBridge rule saa-study-gsa-iceland-monthly still targets ECS directly. Both remain ENABLED. What is the operational risk?

options.A: SQS FIFO ordering is violated for all wiki traffic
options.B: Two Iceland Fargate tasks may start on the same schedule
options.C: CloudFront invalidates all /api/* paths
options.D: Cognito JWTs expire twice as fast

questions.question: The capstone state uses arn:aws:states:::ecs:runTask.sync. The container exits with code 1 after two Step Functions Retries. Catch routes to PublishFailureAlert (SNS). What happens?

options.A: The execution succeeds because Retry exhausted
options.B: Catch runs and publishes to the failure topic — Night 14 pattern
options.C: SQS moves the message to DLQ automatically
options.D: EventBridge FailedInvocations metric increments

questions.question: Which Well-Architected pillar is best demonstrated by Cognito JWT validation on mutating wiki API methods behind API Gateway?

options.A: Sustainability — fewer Lambda invocations
options.B: Security — authenticate and authorize before business logic
options.C: Cost Optimization — JWTs are free
options.D: Performance Efficiency — JWT parsing is faster than SQL

questions.question: Config reports NON_COMPLIANT on a public S3 bucket that still serves static HTML through CloudFront. Site works. Strongest Security-pillar fix for the edge tier?

options.A: Disable all CloudFront caching to reduce attack surface
options.B: Run Athena queries on the bucket access logs nightly
options.C: OAC + block public access — private bucket with CloudFront origin access
options.D: Move wiki counters from DynamoDB to ElastiCache as source of truth

questions.question: A portfolio reviewer asks where CloudFront ends and ElastiCache begins in GSA. Best answer?

options.A: CloudFront caches HTTP responses at the edge; Redis caches application objects near Aurora in the VPC
options.B: They are interchangeable — pick one CDN layer
options.C: ElastiCache replaces Aurora for resort_stats
options.D: CloudFront runs inside private subnets next to Lambda

questions.question: Live wiki visitor counter increments need millisecond writes with ACID. Historical 'resorts per country for three years' runs on S3 Iceberg. Which pairing is correct?

options.A: Athena INSERT for live counter; ElastiCache for the report
options.B: Instance Store for live counter; Glacier for the report
options.C: CloudFront invalidation for live counter; Route 53 geolocation for the report
options.D: DynamoDB for live counter; Athena SQL on Iceberg for the report

questions.question: After lifecycle moves old iceland/ objects to Glacier Flexible Retrieval, finance sees a spike when analysts restore one month for debugging. What exam line item explains the spike?

options.A: NAT Gateway data processing per GB
options.B: Fargate Spot interruption fee
options.C: Glacier retrieval charges — separate from storage class savings
options.D: Intelligent-Tiering monitoring fee on archived objects

questions.question: Night 9 VPC has one NAT Gateway in public subnet AZ-a. Private subnets span two AZs. Biggest Cost Optimization note while labs are idle but VPC remains?

options.A: NAT Gateway hourly + per-GB — tear down VPC or add endpoints when pausing
options.B: CloudFront invalidation cost per path
options.C: Route 53 hosted zone charge per wiki record
options.D: Cognito MAU pricing for anonymous static readers

questions.question: Step Functions InvokeStatsUploader calls Lambda; the function returns HTTP 200 with body {"error": "no rows"}. No Lambda service exception. What does the Task state do?

options.A: Fails immediately and routes to Catch without retry
options.B: Retries until Lambda throws AWSLambdaException
options.C: Waits for EventBridge FailedInvocations
options.D: Succeeds — Retry/Catch apply to integration failures, not business errors in payload

questions.question: Teams want flexible 1-year spend commit across Fargate, Lambda, and EC2 in multiple Regions. Which purchase model fits?

options.A: RDS Reserved Instance for the ECS cluster
options.B: S3 One Zone-IA for all pipeline output
options.C: EC2 Instance Savings Plan locked to m6i.large in us-east-1a only
options.D: Compute Savings Plan

questions.question: Exam scenario: Route 53 failover from PRIMARY ALB in us-east-1 to SECONDARY in us-west-2. Users must flip automatically when primary is unhealthy. What must exist on the PRIMARY record?

options.A: Geolocation policy only — no health check
options.B: Weighted routing 50/50 without health checks
options.C: Latency-based routing among four Regions
options.D: Health check associated with the PRIMARY failover record

questions.question: Night 23 cache-aside Lambda on cache miss for resort_stats. Correct sequence?

options.A: GET Redis → miss → SELECT Aurora → SETEX Redis → return JSON
options.B: Redis read-through proxy pulls Aurora without application code
options.C: CloudFront invalidates then Aurora pushes to Redis
options.D: SNS fan-out triggers Aurora write on every miss

questions.question: EventBridge rule targeting ECS shows FailedInvocations alarm. Same night, ECS task logs show container exit code 1. How do you classify the two signals?

options.A: Both mean the container failed identically
options.B: Both mean IAM denied ecs:RunTask
options.C: Both require SQS DLQ configuration
options.D: FailedInvocations = rule could not invoke target; exit 1 = task ran and failed

questions.question: Iceland pipeline durable GeoJSON must survive Spot interruption and AZ failure. Temp sort files on the worker can be discarded. Where should durable output live?

options.A: EBS gp3 volume attached for the full task lifetime
options.B: Instance Store for maximum sequential throughput
options.C: S3 Standard in the pipeline bucket — system of record
options.D: EFS mounted by every Fargate task for shared output

questions.question: Which integration pattern matches ECS task success → durable handoff → Lambda consumer at human-scale throughput?

options.A: SNS alone — no queue
options.B: Kinesis Video Streams
options.C: EventBridge rule on task success → SQS → Lambda poller
options.D: AppSync subscription on every S3 PUT

questions.question: A 2-hour monthly workflow needs per-step Retry/Catch and full execution history for operators. Sub-5-minute Express volume is not required. Pick orchestration.

options.A: Step Functions Express
options.B: SQS FIFO with deduplication only
options.C: Step Functions Standard
options.D: EventBridge schedule with five independent rules and no shared history

questions.question: Hourly line-item billing exports to S3 for custom Athena cost SQL. Which tool is purpose-built?

options.A: AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR)
options.B: AWS Budgets with SNS only
options.C: CloudWatch Logs Insights on the billing console
options.D: Macie classification jobs

questions.question: Developer registers Fargate task definition with 2048 CPU units (2 vCPU) and 512 MiB memory. Registration fails. Most likely cause?

options.A: Task role must equal execution role name
options.B: EventBridge cannot target tasks above 1 vCPU
options.C: 512 MiB is below the minimum memory allowed for 2 vCPU on Fargate
options.D: awsvpc mode requires assignPublicIp ENABLED for cost savings

questions.question: Night 4 attached AWS WAF to the CloudFront distribution for globalskiatlas.com. Which exam domain does this primarily reinforce?

options.A: Cost Optimization — WAF reduces S3 GET charges
options.B: Database — WAF caches Aurora queries
options.C: Secure architectures — edge HTTP threat protection with managed rule groups
options.D: Migration — WAF replaces DMS

questions.question: Ongoing replication from on-prem PostgreSQL to Aurora with low-latency CDC. One-time bulk load already finished. Which DMS mode?

options.A: Snowball Edge import only
options.B: Athena CTAS on the source database
options.C: S3 Transfer Acceleration
options.D: Full load + CDC task

questions.question: Aurora cluster needs automatic failover for writer failure in the same Region. Read scaling for reporting is secondary. Minimum configuration?

options.A: Multi-AZ Aurora with writer + reader in different AZs
options.B: Single-AZ Aurora with daily manual snapshot only
options.C: DynamoDB global tables for resort_stats
options.D: Athena partitioned table as OLTP store

questions.question: S3 versioning is enabled on a compliance prefix. You want to expire old versions after 90 days but keep current version indefinitely. Which lifecycle feature?

options.A: Noncurrent version transition and expiration rules
options.B: Abort incomplete multipart upload only
options.C: Cross-Region Replication without lifecycle
options.D: Disable versioning and use Intelligent-Tiering only

questions.question: Private subnet Fargate tasks pull container images and write pipeline output without public IPs. Which networking combination reduces NAT data processing?

options.A: VPC gateway endpoints for S3 and interface endpoint for ECR — plus NAT only for other internet
options.B: 0.0.0.0/0 on task security group for simplicity
options.C: Public subnet tasks with assignPublicIp DISABLED
options.D: Remove all route tables — tasks use Instance Store routing

questions.question: Millions of sub-3-minute payment authorization flows per day; no requirement to retain execution history beyond minutes. Orchestration pick?

options.A: Step Functions Standard with 1-year retention
options.B: Step Functions Express
options.C: ECS service always-on with Step Functions Map over 10,000 states
options.D: SQS standard queue without consumers

questions.question: You pause all study labs for three weeks. Which teardown step saves the most idle spend while keeping prod CloudFront and wiki API running?

options.A: Delete WAF on production distribution first
options.B: Remove Cognito user pool used by production wiki
options.C: Run night-34 master teardown through Aurora/ElastiCache/NAT — keep prod edge stacks
options.D: Delete all S3 objects in globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output including current month

questions.question: Practice Exam 1 tonight: 65 questions in 130 minutes. You score 44/65. Best next move before scheduling the real SAA-C03?

options.A: Schedule the real exam tomorrow — close enough
options.B: Skip Night 35 and take Practice Exam 2 immediately
options.C: Memorize every AWS service name alphabetically
options.D: Night 35 weak-area drill on top 3 missed domains — target ≥75% on Exam 2
